claims: Sean Miller is the head men's basketball coach for the University of Texas at Austin.
Sean Miller was hired on March 24, 2025.
Sean Miller was hired to lead the Longhorns for the 2025-26 season.
Sean Miller had previous head coaching roles at Xavier and Arizona.
Sean Miller is the 27th head coach in program history.
Chris Ogden is the general manager.
Vic Schaefer is the women's basketball coach.
Sean Miller spent three seasons in his second stint as the head coach at Xavier University (2022-2025).
